title: Workforce Demographics and Pay Equity
problem_statement: A workforce strategy team needs weighted descriptive evidence on employment and earnings differences across occupations and demographic groups before commissioning deeper equity analysis.
questions: Which occupation groups have the highest weighted earnings?
How does employment vary across demographic groups?
hypotheses: Raw group gaps narrow after stratifying by occupation.
recommendations: Decompose raw gaps by occupation, geography, and hours before interpretation.
Publish weighted estimates with uncertainty and minimum sample-size rules.
